content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

Cloudflare Workers are serverless functions that allow you to run JavaScript at the edge of the network. This means that you can handle requests and responses quickly and efficiently, reducing latency for your users. When integrated with crypto payment systems like NOWPayments, Cloudflare Workers can automate the verification of payments, allowing you to focus on creating and selling your digital products. This approach eliminates the dependency on traditional payment processors, providing you with greater control over your revenue.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of several interconnected components: Cloudflare Workers handle incoming payment requests, while NOWPayments processes these payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies. When a payment is made, the webhook sends a notification to your Cloudflare Workers setup, which can then trigger actions such as confirming the sale and delivering the product. This architecture ensures that transactions are secure and reliable, with low fees—USDT on the Tron network costs under $0.10 per transaction, making it a cost-effective solution.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators in regions facing payment restrictions, such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya. It empowers creators by providing a seamless way to receive payments for their products without relying on traditional banking systems. With the ability to accept cryptocurrencies, creators can tap into a global market, offering their digital goods to anyone, anywhere, without the delays and complications often associated with conventional payment methods.
No need for traditional payment processors—accept crypto directly.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this system include Cloudflare Workers, NOWPayments, and your digital product storage solution, such as Supabase. Cloudflare Workers handle the backend logic while NOWPayments processes the cryptocurrency transactions. The combination of these technologies enables instant payment confirmations, allowing you to automatically deliver digital products right after receiving payment. This integration is crucial for maintaining a smooth purchasing experience for your customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, sign up for NOWPayments and create an account. Next, set up a Cloudflare Workers environment where you will implement the webhook logic. Configure your webhook to listen for payment events from NOWPayments and trigger actions in your backend system. Once your environment is ready, test the entire flow from payment to product delivery. This hands-on approach will ensure you fully understand how the components interact and can adjust them as needed.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments for your digital products, set up a payment processing system using Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments. This combination allows you to handle payments automatically and securely without relying on traditional payment gateways. With low transaction fees, especially on networks like Tron and Solana, you can ensure that your revenue is maximized while minimizing costs.
Instant payment confirmations lead to immediate product delivery.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those looking to dive deeper into setting up a fully operational online store, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197). This stack offers a comprehensive solution including Cloudflare Pages and Workers, ensuring a smooth deployment process. Check out our setup guide at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Set up a self-custody wallet first — Trust Wallet or MetaMask for USDT and other coins, with the private keys stored securely and backed up. Create a NOWPayments account and configure your wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept — start with USDT on Tron and Bitcoin. Set up a P2P exchange account in your country before you need it — Binance P2P, a local exchange, or both. Deploy your stack with NOWPayments configured and the webhook endpoint set. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm USDT arrives in your wallet within the expected confirmation time. Practice a test P2P conversion with a small amount to confirm you know the process end-to-end. When your first real sale arrives, verify it in the database, confirm delivery completed, then convert to local currency through your P2P exchange.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does the Cloudflare Workers webhook work?

The Cloudflare Workers webhook listens for payment notifications from NOWPayments. When a payment is made, the webhook triggers actions in your backend, such as confirming the payment and delivering the product automatically.
What are the fees for using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee on each transaction, which is significantly lower than many traditional payment processors. This fee structure makes it an economical choice for digital creators.
How long does it take for USDT payments to arrive?
USDT payments on the Tron network are confirmed almost instantly, usually within seconds, making them much faster than traditional payment methods like PayPal, which can take several days.
Can I integrate this system with my existing website?
Yes, you can integrate Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments with your existing website. This setup allows you to automate payment processing without changing your current platform.
How can I convert Bitcoin to Naira in Nigeria?

You can use peer-to-peer platforms like Binance or Patricia for Bitcoin to Naira conversions. These platforms allow you to trade cryptocurrencies directly with other users, often at competitive rates.
Low fees make crypto a viable option for creators.
